subtitle: Coffee, tea, and cake
intro: A corner cafe for slow coffee and cake baked this morning. Stay by the window, or take a cup two blocks south to the park.
about: Lotus Cafe is a small room with a short menu. We pull espresso, steep tea, and bake only what we can sell in a day. The olive oil cake usually goes first. If you want a table by the window, weekday mornings are the quiet ones.

offerings.title: Espresso
offerings.detail: A short pull with chocolate, citrus, and a clean finish.

offerings.title: Oat latte
offerings.detail: Espresso and steamed oat milk, lightly sweet, in an 8oz cup.

offerings.title: Batch brew
offerings.detail: One filter coffee on the bar, changed when the pot runs out.

offerings.title: Jasmine green
offerings.detail: A light pot for one. Ask if you want it iced.

offerings.title: Olive oil cake
offerings.detail: Citrus zest and almond. The slice most people come in for.

offerings.title: Chocolate loaf
offerings.detail: Dark cocoa, sliced after noon and served slightly warm.

offerings.title: Morning bun
offerings.detail: Orange sugar, laminated, and baked before we open.

offerings.title: Ricotta toast
offerings.detail: Honey, lemon, and sea salt on thick country bread.
